fato_historico: 1861: Aboriginal Australians kill nineteen Europeans in the Cullin-la-ringo massacre.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find stillness amidst the echoes of the past. Much like the quiet resilience of the earth, you may find that today is a good time to heal old wounds. Perhaps consider nurturing your inner garden; focus on harmony and peace to transform deep-seated turbulence into a soft, steady flow of light.
frase_do_dia: Inner peace is the greatest strength one can cultivate in this vibrant world.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and reaching toward new beginnings.
conselho: Practice gentle forgiveness and allow your heart to release lingering heavy emotions.
